text.p: Tropical Cyclone Ophelia, with 60 mph winds, is south of Java in the Southeast Indian Ocean near 13s/112e, moving southeast at 9 mph. Ophelia will turn more south as top winds increase to near 70 mph during the next 36 hours. It remains well off the Northwest Australia coast at this time, and is only a threat to shipping south of Java.

Tropical Depression 41W is in the far Southern South China sea near 3n/111e, moving east at 9 mph. Top winds are near 30 mph and may weaken slightly during the next 36 hours, remaining over open water as a minor to moderate shipping threat.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
